description_full:
"Ready to power your career journey? ☀️
Greenvolt Power Indonesia is opening its Internship Program. Join us in accelerating Indonesia's renewable energy transition.
📍 Open positions:
• Finance & Accounting
• General Affairs
• Creative Media
• Legal

🗓 Full-time, Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM
⏳ Duration: 4 to 6 months
🚫 No travel required
📩 Applications open year-round

✅ What you'll get:
• Hands-on experience in your field of study
• Mentorship from industry professionals
• A collaborative, purpose-driven team
• Internship certificate and recommendation letter upon successful completion

📩 How to apply: Send your Cover Letter and CV to people.indonesia@greenvolt.com with the subject ""Application Internship Program - [Position]""

Tag a friend who'd be a great fit! 👇
